subtitle: Out Cebu · Cebu Pacific
overview: A five-day Kansai tour starting with an early-morning arrival in Osaka and going straight into Kyoto sightseeing. Walk Ninenzaka and Sannenzaka, visit Kiyomizu Temple and Fushimi Inari Shrine, try a matcha experience, then see Nara’s deer and Todaiji Temple. A free day leaves room for an optional Universal Studios Japan trip. Fly Cebu – Osaka with Cebu Pacific; stay in 3–4-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Mar 4–8 2027 to Apr 21–25 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Ninenzaka: A preserved stone-paved slope in Kyoto's Higashiyama district lined with traditional shops.
placeDesc.Sannenzaka: A historic sloping lane in Kyoto's Higashiyama district, leading toward Kiyomizu Temple.
placeDesc.Kiyomizu Temple: A famous Kyoto temple with a large wooden terrace overlooking the city.
placeDesc.Fushimi Inari Shrine: A Kyoto shrine famous for its thousands of red torii gates winding up a mountain.
placeDesc.Nara Deer Park: A park in Nara where tame deer roam freely among the temples.
placeDesc.Todaiji Temple: A Nara temple housing a giant bronze Buddha, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Osaka Castle: A reconstructed 16th-century castle in Osaka, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Umeda Sky Building: A twin-tower skyscraper in Osaka connected by a rooftop observatory, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Namba Yasaka Shrine: An Osaka shrine known for its huge lion-head stage building.
placeDesc.Rinku Premium Outlets: An outlet shopping centre near Kansai Airport, visited on Day 4.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Japan: A theme park in Osaka offered as an optional tour on the free day.
